Ruling: batch #7 item 5 · letter B · maintainer 「objectui 三个都同意」 2026-10-23T16:08:53Z

The maintainer's 「同意」 takes this card's recommendation **B**: Setup record pages no longer draw the floating `ManagedByBadge`; the header's type chip carries the managed-by note on hover (e.g. 「组织 · 由身份系统管理，部分字段不可直接编辑」). This amends objectui#12194 option a (comment 6120170778) for Setup record pages only; list headers (`ObjectView.tsx`) and business-app record pages keep the badge under the existing `useCanAuthorMetadata()` gate. Options A (keep) and C (no record page draws it) were not chosen.

**Workload of the chosen letter:** S, one `domain:ui` PR — a Setup-scope condition around the badge in `RecordDetailView.tsx` (L3578 on main `3a73c07`; whether Setup is read from the route or from the `sys_*` object is the seat's call), the header chip's hover text, tests. #12614 narrows to its item 2 and returns to `pm:queue` (p2, `domain:ui`). Done when: the Setup `sys_organization` record page has no floating badge, the header chip's hover shows the managed-by note, business-object record pages are unchanged, 1280 px screenshots light and dark.

Labels: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; the ui seat dispatches (裁不派). Brief: https://claude.ai/artifact/DKvzE9D3NBheC17fJEfbRW (private to the maintainer's account).

Claim amendment · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01WJozybDmRH8z2c5SD7vJkj` · 2026-10-23T19:41Z

**File surface, widened by three files:** the header's type chip is not drawn by app-shell. It is the object label inside `RecordTitleChip` (`@object-ui/components`), drawn by the `page:header` renderer (`PageHeaderRenderer`). `RecordDetailView` reaches it only through the page tree. The host-to-header path follows the existing host-injected `RecordContext` field pattern (`headerSystemActions`):
- `packages/react/src/context/RecordContext.tsx`: `RecordContextValue` gains an optional host-injected `objectLabelNote`.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (`PageHeaderRenderer`): passes it to the chip.
- `packages/components/src/custom/RecordTitleChip.tsx`: gains an optional `objectLabelNote` prop. When it is set, the object label becomes a focusable tooltip trigger, using the chip's existing tooltip idiom.

**Clause-②: yes** (widening: `RecordContextValue` and `RecordTitleChip`'s props each gain one optional member; nothing is refused). This replaces the claim's `Clause-②: no`. The seat posts the contract review on the PR.

Nothing else changes in the claim. Setup is detected from the route (`isSetupAppSegment`, as `ObjectView` already does). The note reuses `ManagedByBadge`'s `managedByBadge.<key>.title` strings, so no new locale keys are added. It keeps the `useCanAuthorMetadata()` gate.
